bibl.title: The Councillor and the Clerk: Class and Culture on a Roman Frontier.
bibl.seg: Roger S. Bagnall, The Councillor and the Clerk: Class and Culture on a Roman Frontier.
bibl.note: Presidential address 2017, Toronto, Canada. - Both the councillor Serenos of Trimithis and "Ego", the steward who authored the Kellis Agricultural Account Book (P. Kell. IV 96) were well above average in wealth and education; but not even Serenos was so detached from the broader spectrum as to be free of compromises, and Ego had more in common than of difference with Serenos.
